name: Shipping chokepoints
value: Hormuz largely shut; record 30 attacks in Oct
summary: Record ship attacks in October; India-flagged vessel hit off Oman on 3 Nov
state: UKMTO reported a record 30 attacks on commercial vessels in October, and an India-flagged vessel was struck off Oman on 3 Nov, killing one crew member (CBS). The US struck Iranian surface-to-air missile sites near Hormuz on 2 Nov (AP). Mediators are working on a framework trading an end to strait attacks for lifting the US blockade.
for_you: Follow UKMTO and flag-state maritime advisories; shipping and insurance costs for Gulf routes stay high.

sources.title: CBS News — Iran war live updates
AP — US strikes Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz
Euronews — Iran says it can reopen Hormuz in two days

why: Around 30% of seaborne oil and much container trade passes Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb/Suez, Panama and Malacca; disruption raises prices worldwide.
drivers: Houthi/Iran attacks, war-risk insurance, drought (Panama), naval incidents, piracy.

rubric.alert: Hormuz traffic materially impeded, or any chokepoint closed, or two or more disrupted at once.
rubric.watch: One chokepoint disrupted (attacks, large-scale diversions, draught restrictions).
